name: sample-119-s32-your-organization-now-has-goals-projects
subject: Your organization now has Goals, Projects, and more
latest_message:
Give users access to these platform apps

Goals and Projects are now available in your organization. These platform apps help users share regular status updates and track progress toward objectives. They're free for all customers.

You manage access to Goals and Projects the same way you manage access to other Atlassian apps in Atlassian Administration. How to give users access to apps ( https://support.atlassian.com/user-management/docs/give-users-access-to-products/ )

What's a goal? ( https://support.atlassian.com/platform-experiences/docs/what-is-a-goal/ )

What's a project? ( https://support.atlassian.com/platform-experiences/docs/what-is-a-project/ )

You'll also find bonus new features, like topics and kudos, in Atlassian Home as part of this release. About Atlassian Home ( https://support.atlassian.com/platform-experiences/docs/what-is-atlassian-home/ )

Manage access ( https://admin.atlassian.com/o/0c0b8af7-9e3a-4b74-a6a1-e906260f80ad/products?cloudId=cfc4c321-f799
